report.title: Incorrect Transfer Success Heading
report.summary: The ParaBank website displays incorrect text on the transfer success heading. The expected text is 'Transfer Done!', but the actual text is 'Transfer Complete!'.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in to the ParaBank website.
2. Navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
3. Initiate a transfer of $10 from account #521835 to account #521835.
report.expected: The transfer success heading should display 'Transfer Done!'.
report.actual: The transfer success heading displays 'Transfer Complete!'.
evidence: Locator expected to have text 'Transfer Done!' Actual value: Transfer Complete!
report.suspected_cause: The page's heading text is incorrect.
report.next_action: The development team should investigate and correct the heading text to display the expected 'Transfer Done!' text.
